avatar.name: Masculine
avatar.desc: The masculine body: every suit, lower body and head part is fitted to it.

avatar.name: Feminine
avatar.desc: The feminine body: every suit, lower body and head part is fitted to it.

avatar.name: Face 1
avatar.desc: The base face.

avatar.name: Face 2
avatar.desc: A face of its own; face shields and masks are fitted to each face.

avatar.name: Face 3
avatar.desc: A face of its own; face shields and masks are fitted to each face.

avatar.name: Face 4
avatar.desc: A face of its own; face shields and masks are fitted to each face.

avatar.name: Face 5
avatar.desc: A face of its own (0.3.27); face shields and masks are the base face's.

avatar.name: Face 6
avatar.desc: A face of its own (0.3.27); face shields and masks are the base face's. The masculine FACE 6 is clean-shaven: FACIAL HAIR decides.

avatar.name: Mustache
avatar.desc: A mustache over the upper lip, fitted to each face, in the hair colour (0.3.27).

avatar.name: Goatee
avatar.desc: A goatee: a mustache and a beard on the chin, fitted to each face, in the hair colour (0.3.27).

avatar.name: Short Beard
avatar.desc: A short beard along the jaw from the sideburns, fitted to each face, in the hair colour (0.3.27).

avatar.name: Long Beard
avatar.desc: A long beard hanging below the chin, fitted to each face, in the hair colour; it sways as you move (0.3.27).

avatar.name: Grid Runner
avatar.desc: Long-sleeve bodysuit with glowing circuit piping, a high collar and cuff rings.

avatar.name: Arena Jersey
avatar.desc: Loose crew-neck sports tee: short sleeves with trim bands, trim collar and side stripes. Also the team kit of every COUNTRY (COUNTRY KIT: TEAM JERSEY; MY OUTFIT keeps your own suit in its colours).

avatar.name: Vanguard
avatar.desc: Dark undersuit with raised armour: one smooth chest plate, back plate, pauldrons, vambraces and a glowing core.

avatar.name: Street Jacket
avatar.desc: Padded long-sleeve jacket with a high collar, zipper line, trim cuffs and waistband.

avatar.name: Hoodie
avatar.desc: Thick hoodie with a kangaroo pocket, trim cuffs and waistband.

avatar.name: Echo Suit
avatar.desc: Sleek long-sleeve racer suit: high collar, glowing V lines and an identity disc on the back.

avatar.name: Tank Top
avatar.desc: Tank top with a round neckline and wide straps, silver-plated forearm bracers.

avatar.name: Pilot
avatar.desc: Flight suit with harness straps, a belt and a chest light.

avatar.name: Circuit Vest
avatar.desc: Sleeveless compression vest: mock collar, glowing chest Y, side and back lines, dark circuit bracers.

avatar.name: Training Tee
avatar.desc: Fitted training tee with raglan and side panels in the trim colour, grey-plated bracers.

avatar.name: Circuit Runner
avatar.desc: Body suit with modelled circuit traces, pulses running along them.

avatar.name: Grid Runner Live
avatar.desc: The Grid Runner with its glow lines raised from the suit, pulsing.

avatar.name: Echo Suit Live
avatar.desc: The Echo Suit with its glow lines raised from the suit, pulsing.

avatar.name: Circuit Vest Live
avatar.desc: The Circuit Vest with its glow lines raised from the suit, pulsing.

avatar.name: Vector
avatar.desc: Athletic kit made with a member of the community, with shorts of its own for the first four LOWER BODY choices.

avatar.name: Nightforge
avatar.desc: Armoured kit made with a member of the community, with shorts of its own for the first four LOWER BODY choices.

avatar.name: Ronin Wrap
avatar.desc: Wrap jacket crossed to the left hip over a dark undershirt, a raised obi with a tied knot, three layered shoulder lames, long sleeves with glowing cuffs.

avatar.name: Peluru Tuxedo
avatar.desc: A charro jacket made with a member of the community: white shirt front and bow tie, an embroidered bandolier, satin lapels and tails, flowers in the glow colour.

avatar.name: Peluru Layered Dress
avatar.desc: An off-shoulder folk dress made with a member of the community: a flounced neckline, an embroidered bodice and a layered skirt that sways (the viewer shows it at rest), with hoop earrings that swing.

avatar.name: Dragon Silk Qipao
avatar.desc: Crimson silk with a gold dragon, its skirt in the LOWER BODY's place (0.3.27). With a COUNTRY and MY OUTFIT, in the flag's colours.

avatar.name: Cherry Poodle Skirt
avatar.desc: A felt circle skirt with a poodle on its lead, a white blouse, a neck scarf and a buttoned belt; the skirt swishes and twirls as you move (see THE SWISH under Pose or animation) and takes the LOWER BODY's place (0.3.27). With a COUNTRY and MY OUTFIT, in the flag's colours.

avatar.name: None
avatar.desc: The body ends at the waist in an energy fade.

avatar.name: Athletic Shorts
avatar.desc: Athletic shorts with a split hem and white piping; the thighs fade above the knee.

avatar.name: Circuit Shorts
avatar.desc: Long circuit shorts with glowing lines down the legs and on the waistband.

avatar.name: Bike Shorts
avatar.desc: Bike shorts with side panels in the trim colour.

avatar.name: Long Shorts
avatar.desc: Opaque long shorts that cover the thighs.

avatar.name: Tennis Skirt
avatar.desc: A tennis skirt over undershorts; it swings as you move (the viewer shows it at rest).

avatar.name: Kilt
avatar.desc: A kilt over undershorts; it swings as you move (the viewer shows it at rest).

avatar.name: Striker
avatar.desc: Gothic plate: pointed finger scales, knuckle gadlings, a fluted back plate, a pointed bell cuff.

avatar.name: Titan
avatar.desc: Heavy plate: thick scales, a spiked knuckle ridge, a riveted back plate, a wide bell cuff.

avatar.name: Phantom
avatar.desc: Light plate over a dark glove with glowing inlays and a slim cuff.

avatar.name: Controller
avatar.desc: The classic look: the VR controller in an armoured glove.

avatar.name: Grappler
avatar.desc: Heavy plating with hooked talons and hydraulic pistons; in the game its fingers open on the trigger and a plasma tether runs to the ball.

avatar.name: Arc Claw
avatar.desc: Slim plate with glowing joint nodes and lines; in the game its fingers open on the trigger.

avatar.name: Regalia
avatar.desc: Gold plates with black filigree and a faceted jewel in the glow colour; in the game its fingers open on the trigger.

avatar.name: Slim
avatar.desc: Slimmer shoulders and arms.

avatar.name: Standard
avatar.desc: The base proportions.

avatar.name: Broad
avatar.desc: Broader shoulders and chest, thicker arms.

avatar.name: Athletic
avatar.desc: Slightly broader, stronger arms.

avatar.name: Strong
avatar.desc: STRONG (0.3.27): a body of its own, every outfit shaped to it by a grid of movements baked from the outfits made for it.

avatar.name: Lean
avatar.desc: LEAN on the masculine body, SOFT on the feminine (0.3.27): a body of its own, every outfit shaped to it by a grid of movements baked from the outfits made for it.

avatar.name: Circuit
avatar.desc: Circuit traces with pads, in the glow colour.

avatar.name: Stripes
avatar.desc: Twin racing stripes front and back, pinstripes on the sides.

avatar.name: Chevron
avatar.desc: Chevrons across the chest.

avatar.name: Hex
avatar.desc: Honeycomb lines with trim-colour cells.

avatar.name: Split
avatar.desc: Left half in the trim colour.

avatar.name: Pixel
avatar.desc: Digital camo blocks in the trim colour.

avatar.name: Bands
avatar.desc: Horizontal bands in the trim colour.

avatar.name: Buzz Cut
avatar.desc: Close-cropped.

avatar.name: Swept
avatar.desc: Volume on top, swept back in layers.

avatar.name: Ponytail
avatar.desc: Combed back to a high tie, a full wavy tail and face-framing strands.

avatar.name: Mohawk
avatar.desc: Shaved sides with a crest from brow to nape.

avatar.name: Spikes
avatar.desc: Short spikes swept back.

avatar.name: Bob
avatar.desc: Chin-length bob with a fringe.

avatar.name: Top Knot
avatar.desc: Shaved with a bun on top.

avatar.name: Tousled
avatar.desc: Short and layered, swept up and to the side, ends flicking out.

avatar.name: High Pigtails
avatar.desc: Two high ties, each tail springing up and out before it falls; they swing as you move.

avatar.name: Dreadlocks
avatar.desc: Locs in two staggered rows with beads and cuffs, swept back behind the ears; they swing as you move.

avatar.name: Side Part
avatar.desc: Parted at the side and swept across, over the ears to the nape (0.3.27).

avatar.name: French Crop
avatar.desc: Short and textured on top with a short fringe, the sides cut close (0.3.27).

avatar.name: Short Crop
avatar.desc: Cropped short all over, a little longer on top (0.3.27).

avatar.name: Low Ponytail
avatar.desc: Combed straight back from the brow and tied low at the nape (0.3.27).

avatar.name: Grid Helmet
avatar.desc: Full helmet with a glowing face rim, midline and side lines.

avatar.name: Racer Helmet
avatar.desc: Rounded racing helmet with twin stripes and a rear spoiler.

avatar.name: Hood
avatar.desc: Soft fabric hood with a trim edge.

avatar.name: Crest Helmet
avatar.desc: Helmet with a crest fin and cheek guards.

avatar.name: Headphones
avatar.desc: Over-ear headphones with glowing rings (hair stays visible).

avatar.name: Cap
avatar.desc: Cap with a curved brim.

avatar.name: Horned Helmet
avatar.desc: A horned helmet, made with a member of the community.

avatar.name: Vector Helmet
avatar.desc: The Vector kit's helmet, made with a member of the community.

avatar.name: Ronin Kabuto
avatar.desc: An open-faced samurai-style helmet: a ribbed bowl, a laced neck guard, cheek wings and a glowing crescent crest.

avatar.name: Sombrero
avatar.desc: A wide-brimmed sombrero with embroidered bands and a flower cluster, made with a member of the community.

avatar.name: Band Visor
avatar.desc: Wraparound glass band over the eyes, glowing edges.

avatar.name: Full Shield
avatar.desc: Smooth glass dome over the whole face.

avatar.name: Shades
avatar.desc: Sunglasses.

avatar.name: Goggles
avatar.desc: Round goggles on a strap.

avatar.name: Headset
avatar.desc: A VR headset on a strap.

avatar.name: Halo
avatar.desc: A glowing ring orbiting the head, with a slim eye line.

avatar.name: Slit Visor
avatar.desc: Opaque plate with a glowing eye slit.

avatar.name: Mouth Guard
avatar.desc: Plate over the mouth and chin with vents.

avatar.name: Cyber Jaw
avatar.desc: Armoured jaw from ear to ear with glowing vents.

avatar.name: Breather
avatar.desc: Respirator: snout, side filters and straps.

avatar.name: Bandana
avatar.desc: Cloth over nose and mouth, knotted at the back; its point and its tails swing.

avatar.name: Faceplate
avatar.desc: Smooth full-face plate with glowing eye slits.

avatar.name: Sugar Skull
avatar.desc: A sugar-skull mask fitted to each face, made with a member of the community: eye holes, dotted rings and flowers in the trim and glow colours.

arena.name: Neon glass court
arena.desc: Transparent glass walls, roof and back walls with the neon tube outline, floor markings and player rings.

arena.name: Polished floor
arena.desc: Dark polished tiles with the pale runway and team-tinted end zones, lit by the baked lightmap (T13).

arena.name: Glow, holograms and hex energy
arena.desc: Soft halos around every neon tube, hex energy on the end-zone glass and, faint in the team's colour, on the back walls, the faint floor grid, the overhead light shafts (0.3.27: no rings on the back walls or in the floor; the only rings are the strike zones).

arena.name: Energy pulses
arena.desc: Cards along each neon tube that the game scrolls so energy pulses race around the outline (texture T12).

arena.name: Floor reflection
arena.desc: The court mirrored below the floor; seen through the glossy floor it makes the reflections.

arena.name: Stadium
arena.desc: Dais rim, the slat light galleries, tiered stands with the crowd, the overhead rig with spotlights, the screen block and the sky dome.

arena.name: Crowd lights
arena.desc: Twinkling phone and light-stick glows in the crowd (texture T07, scrolled by the game).

arena.name: Stadium glow
arena.desc: The stadium's light beams and halos (hidden in PASSTHROUGH).

arena.name: Stadium reflection
arena.desc: The stadium mirrored below the floor.

arena.name: Court outline
arena.desc: PASSTHROUGH > OUTLINE: only the court's neon edges and floor lines, drawn over your room.

props.name: Plasma ball
props.desc: The energy sphere (additive, swirling veins T08). The game adds the core, trails and electric arcs (C03).

props.name: Filament orbits
props.desc: Three hair-thin glowing orbits with sparks that spin with the ball and show its curve.

props.name: Spawn pad
props.desc: The floor pad in front of each player, glowing in the team colour; the ball rises from it.

props.name: Controller gauntlet
props.desc: GAUNTLET = CONTROLLER: a VR controller held in an armoured glove; the glass knuckle guard floats in front of it.

props.name: Knuckle guard
props.desc: The clear glass bumper in front of the fist (it matches the punch collision box). Drawn translucent.

props.name: Hex shield
props.desc: The energy shield that forms while you hold a charged ball (hex texture T04, bright rim).

props.name: Strike ring
props.desc: The holographic ring round each player's strike zone (texture T03); from 0.3.27 the zone inside it is frosted glass in the player's colour (drawn by the game), both exactly as big as the room's STRIKE ZONE scores. Any part of the ball crossing inside is a strike.

props.name: Old android head
props.desc: The first placeholder head, used only if the avatar parts are missing.

props.name: Old android torso
props.desc: The first placeholder torso, used only if the avatar parts are missing.

props.name: Striker gauntlet
props.desc: GAUNTLET = STRIKER (the default): gothic plate. Overlapping scales on every finger with pointed tips, a knuckle ridge with gadlings, a fluted back plate, a thumb wing and a pointed bell cuff. Drawn as the fist and the cuff (gauntlet_0 is the whole piece).

props.name: Titan gauntlet
props.desc: GAUNTLET = TITAN: heavy plate. Thick finger scales, a spiked knuckle ridge, a ridged and riveted back plate and a wide bell cuff.

props.name: Phantom gauntlet
props.desc: GAUNTLET = PHANTOM: light plate over a dark glove. Thin finger scales, a smooth knuckle ridge and back plate with glowing inlays, a slim cuff.

props.name: Air guitar
props.desc: The hologram guitar a practice bot plays when it wins a match with AIR GUITAR, in its glow colour (additive plasma, veins T08). See it played: Avatar builder, Pose or animation, AIR GUITAR.

tex.name: Soft strip
tex.desc: The soft band used for every halo and glow line.

tex.name: Night sky
tex.desc: Starfield and violet nebula on the sky dome.

tex.name: Project Arena emblem
tex.desc: The centre-court logo and the screens.

tex.name: Stroke font
tex.desc: Every letter on the scoreboard, the menus and the hub.

tex.name: Energy pulse
tex.desc: Pulses racing along the neon tubes.

tex.name: Court lightmap
tex.desc: Baked light on the court and floor (from the neon, galleries and rig).

tex.name: Stadium lightmap
tex.desc: Baked light on the stands, dais and rig.

tex.name: Fabric knit
tex.desc: The knit every garment shows up close (repeated across the cloth).

sounds.name: Ball appears
sounds.desc: A small soft bloom with a faint glint as a new ball appears on its launcher.

sounds.name: Launcher rises
sounds.desc: A gentle airy swell as the launcher lifts out of the floor.

sounds.name: Grab
sounds.desc: A muted thump and a brief warm hum when you take the ball.

sounds.name: Catch
sounds.desc: A padded catch with a quick soft rise.

sounds.name: Throw (slow)
sounds.desc: A soft low whoosh, the gentlest throw.

sounds.name: Throw (medium)
sounds.desc: A clean whoosh, a little brighter.

sounds.name: Throw (fast)
sounds.desc: A quicker, brighter whoosh with a faint streak.

sounds.name: Throw (full power)
sounds.desc: The fullest whoosh with a soft low push.

sounds.name: Dropped throw
sounds.desc: A soft falling tone and faint fizzle when a release is too slow.

sounds.name: Wall bounce
sounds.desc: A short soft tok off the glass.

sounds.name: Shield block
sounds.desc: A resonant soft thoom with a short glassy shimmer.

sounds.name: Shield break
sounds.desc: The shield shattering: a community contribution, layered from three sound effects.

sounds.name: Knuckle punch
sounds.desc: A tight padded metallic knock.

sounds.name: You scored
sounds.desc: A soft deep thud, a gentle discharge and a small rising two-note chime.

sounds.name: You were hit
sounds.desc: A muffled heavy thud with a low downward wobble.

sounds.name: Ball returns
sounds.desc: An airy whoosh moving away as the ball flies home.

sounds.name: Foul
sounds.desc: Two rounded falling notes.

sounds.name: Countdown beep
sounds.desc: One calm low beep for each count.

sounds.name: Round start
sounds.desc: A short bright swell landing on a soft chord.

sounds.name: Round won
sounds.desc: A small crowd cheering and clapping.

sounds.name: Round lost
sounds.desc: A small crowd "ohh" with a few claps.

sounds.name: Match won
sounds.desc: Crowd cheers and applause over a soft major chord.

sounds.name: Match lost
sounds.desc: Warm applause over a gentle falling chord.

sounds.name: Recharge
sounds.desc: A short soft rise and a gentle ding when your ball recharges.

sounds.name: Strike
sounds.desc: A clear two-note ding-ding over a soft swell.

sounds.name: Sudden death
sounds.desc: A voice calls SUDDEN DEATH.

sounds.name: Arena ambience
sounds.desc: A quiet 30-second loop: low hum, air and a distant crowd.

sounds.name: Fist bump
sounds.desc: A friendly metallic knock and a warm pulse when two players bump fists to start.

sounds.name: Crowd
sounds.desc: A short, quiet crowd blip each time the fans cheer on their phones (The Crowd).

sounds.name: Crowd cheer
sounds.desc: The crowd erupts: a rising cheer with applause.

sounds.name: Clock tick
sounds.desc: A very soft wooden tick once a second in the last 10 seconds of a timed match.

sounds.name: Lead change
sounds.desc: A bright rising three-note chime when someone new leads (FOUR CORNERS).

sounds.name: Target hit
sounds.desc: A bright glassy ping when a TRAINING target is taken.

sounds.name: Hard punch
sounds.desc: A hard crack when a knuckle guard punch sends the ball back at 12 m/s or more (new in 0.3.21; a SOUND STUDIO slot from 0.3.22).

code.name: Hit plasma burst
code.desc: Flash, shock ring, swirling plasma puffs, curling wisps and lingering sparks in the scorer's colour; a colour wash for the player who was hit.

code.name: Spawn glow and rise
code.desc: Glow gathers on the pad, then the ball floats up with twisting tracers.

code.name: Electric arcs
code.desc: Jagged arcs crackling over the ball, re-rolled 18 times a second.

code.name: Ball trails
code.desc: A soft-edged trail plus two helix streaks that show the spin.

code.name: Ball light pool and reflection
code.desc: Coloured light on the floor under the ball, and its reflection in the floor.

code.name: Holographic scoreboard
code.desc: The translucent board over centre court with team-coloured scores, clock, strikes and charge.

code.name: Menus
code.desc: Floating panels with the laser pointer: play, rooms and their options, settings.

code.name: Spectator hub
code.desc: Live miniature arenas on pedestals; point and pull the trigger to watch one.

code.name: Avatar builder
code.desc: A mirror that copies your movements, with a pointer panel beside it for every choice in the AVATAR section here.

code.name: Avatar rig and rim light
code.desc: The torso hung below the neck, two-bone arms reaching your real hands, the team-colour rim light and the waist fade. This viewer poses avatars with the same rig.

code.name: The fans' flags
code.desc: With The Crowd cheering from their phones, a flag on a pole waves in an end's stands for each phone (up to 40), faster as the hype rises, and cheer bursts throw hearts, stars and little flags up out of the stands: the end's country flag (the F IDs), or with no country a foam finger in the end's colour.

code.name: The gutter
code.desc: THE GUTTER (0.3.27): the curved cove where the side walls meet the floor in the SQUARE, DIAMOND and FOUR CORNERS (12 cm as standard; the host picks OFF, 12, 25 or 40 cm), lit glass facets with a neon line where it meets each face and a fainter one down its middle; past each foul line, in that end's colour. A ball comes off it as off a wall.

code.name: Players in the floor
code.desc: FLOOR REFLECTIONS (0.3.27): the players and bots mirrored in the polished floor, fading with depth, their legs ending in a portal's glow. Your own reflection is left out.

code.name: The jump rope
code.desc: THE ROPE (0.3.27), a practice bot's victory: a hologram cord in its glow colour from handle to handle, turned in big circles, bending along the floor where it slaps down and kicking up a few white-gold sparks. See it turned: Avatar builder, Pose or animation, THE ROPE.

anims.name: Breathing, its hands drifting, its weight shifting, glancing about
Come on: a beckon with both hands
Here I am: arms spread wide
MONKEY: bouncing, its arms shaken out
KARATE: a bow, a fist in its palm
RAISE THE ROOF: pushed up from its head
THE ROPE: a jump rope turned in big circles, a jump each turn
